sources.read_scope: selected complete keyword definitions and capitalization clarification, not an IETF governance certification
supported_claims: Necessary, recommended and optional requirements are distinct; valid recommendation deviations require considering consequences.
RFC 8174 keyword meanings apply to uppercase English usage; other text can still be normative.
unsupported_inferences: No IETF-prescribed Chinese translation, project role assignment or adoption decision.

sources.read_scope: selected specification clauses on public API, immutable released contents, version increments and prereleases
supported_claims: A SemVer user declares a public API; incompatible API changes, compatible additions and compatible fixes have different increments.
Released version contents are not replaced; initial-development and prerelease status have their stated limits.
unsupported_inferences: No mandatory SemVer for every research/document identity; no automatic adoption, deployment or permanent compatibility guarantee.

sources.read_scope: selected Table 1 tasks and adjacent notional-example distinction; not the entire publication or cited secondary frameworks
supported_claims: Maintain SDLC roles and responsibilities; define security-check criteria and safeguard supporting information.
Code access follows least privilege; credible vulnerability reports are investigated and disclosure/remediation roles and policy are implemented.
unsupported_inferences: Not a required team size, fixed SLA, actual platform configuration, general legal rule or product security certification.

organization_rule_basis: Other governance procedures are Standards design choices justified by their failure models and acceptance contracts, not attributed wholesale to these sources.
